subject: Ronaldo Nazario (R9)
title: R9: promoted after losing, and a fake goal

lines.vo: Lost two-nil and still promoted? Welcome to Ronaldo's business world.

lines.vo: They lost nil-two to Ferroviaria, yet went up on a one-goal margin. Their first Serie B place in thirty-five years.

lines.vo: This week a viral video showed a Ronaldo wonder goal. The fact check says it is AI. Two hundred and fifty-seven thousand likes. Fake goal, real applause.

lines.vo: At fifty, he runs a beach club with a twenty-five-thousand square-metre artificial beach. Tennis memberships cost 1.15 million reais each. Serve, volley, or remortgage.

notes: Ronaldo is described as an investor in the Inter de Limeira SAF, not an owner. The AI video is named as fake per the fact check (La Republica), not as a Ronaldo quote. 'Fake goal, real applause' and 'old habits' are opinion jokes on likes and sales. 'Remortgage' is a joke on the R$1.15m membership price, not a fee claim. The court case and the Liv Drinks debt are left out completely. The Paysandu/STJD challenge is pending and is not mentioned. Insert after_line values are 0-based.
